narrations.text: Software Model Normalization (SUMN). From Raw Fingerprints to Canonical Models
Discovery finds 40 variants of "Microsoft Office": Office16, Office15, O365ProPlus, MSOffice2019... Without normalization: catastrophic under-licensing on some variants, untracked installs on others.

Normalization Workflow. 1. Discovery/SUMN collects raw fingerprints → creates Discovery Model 2. SUMN matches to Content Library publisher packs → Software Model 3. Unmatched → Normalization Queue for manual review 4. Admin maps: Normalize action or Ignore 5. Normalized installs → Reconciliation. Normalize FIRST, then entitle. Unnormalized = unlicensed = audit risk.
Six Normalization Statuses. New No No Match Not Found Yes No Publisher Normalized Yes Yes Partially Normalized Yes Yes Normalized No Yes Manually Normalized No No

Content Library & Publisher Packs. ServiceNow-maintained publisher packs: Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe, IBM, SAP, 100+ Contains: Software models, normalization rules, suite definitions, license metrics Auto-updated via plugin com.snc.samp.content.library Verify plugin active: com.snc.sams (SAM Pro) + com.snc.iam (ITAM).

SUITE ROLL-UP IS CRITICAL Oracle DB EE, Microsoft Office, Adobe CC = SUITES Components must roll up to suite for correct counting Without suite membership: 500 Word + 500 Excel + 500 PPT = 1,500 licenses!

Key Normalization Jobs. Normalize using Content Library rules Daily Auto-match discovery models Discovery Model Normalization job Daily Process normalization queue Discovery Model → Software Model matching Not documented Model matching ML Normalization (opt-in) Daily AI-assisted matching Wide-net Normalization (opt-in) Daily Broader pattern matching
